23.04.2026 Impleadment Application No. IA/13003/2022
Delay Condonation Application No. IA/13034/2023
Substitution Application No. IA/13035/2023
In 
WPMS No. 44 of 2019
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Kshitij Sah, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Sushil Vashisth, Standing Counsel for the 
State.
Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, Advocate for the 
respondent.
2. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, Advocate as well as 
learned State Counsel submit that they do not 
propose to file any objection to the delay 
condonation application or the substitution 
application. 
3. The explanation offered for delay of 59 days in 
filing Substitution Application is satisfactory. 
Accordingly, delay is condoned. Delay condonation 
application stands allowed.
4. For the reasons indicated, Substitution 
application is allowed. Let amended memo of parties 
by filed within one week.
5. In this writ petition, petitioners have made 
prayer for adding three persons as petitioner Nos. 
230, 231 and 232. This prayer, however, is opposed 
by learned counsel for the respondents who contend  that no one can be added as petitioner after seven 
years of filing of the writ petition.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioners, however, 
submits that Impleadment Application was filed in 
2022.
7. Be that as it may, this Court is not inclined to 
allow the prayer for impleadment at this belated 
stage. The persons to whom petitioners want to be 
added in this writ petition may file separate writ 
petition, if so advised.
8. Impleadment Application (IA/13003/2022) is 
rejected.
9. List on 21.05.2026.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
 23.04.2026 Mahinder/
